rendered.overview: This 5-color deck centers on [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]], triggering waterbending, earthbending, firebending, and airbending to draw cards and flip into a devastating back face that drains opponents and refills the hand. Lesson spells, Shrines, and Ally synergies build a wide, value-dense board, while [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] combos with the Aangs for infinite tokens as a backup. The deck grinds opponents down through card advantage and incremental board development rather than a single fast kill.
weaknesses: Moderate: The deck leans on enchantments like [[Sanctum of Calm Waters]] and [[Firebender Ascension]] with only [[Origin of Metalbending]] as answer back.
Moderate: Only 2 interaction cards, with just 1 at instant speed, leaves the deck slow to stop a fast combo like reanimating [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].
Moderate: Without [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] in play, the card draw engine and transform payoff disappear entirely.

plans.primary: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]], trigger each bending type to draw cards and transform into the back face for a huge life, draw, and damage swing.
backups: Assemble [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] or [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] to generate infinite creature ETBs and tokens.
Use Lesson spells and earthbend/airbend effects to grind value and build an Ally board that attacks for damage.

rendered.overview: Jeskai Gods built around [[Kratos, Stoic Father]] and [[Atreus, Impulsive Son]]. Attacking with Gods and Gods dying generate experience counters, which [[Kratos, Stoic Father]] dumps onto a creature each end step while [[Atreus, Impulsive Son]] turns the same counters into draws and burn. Proliferate support and extra combats like [[World at War]] push the counters and damage further, while [[Otharri, Suns' Glory]] converts counters into an attacking token army.

Spend counters with [[Atreus, Impulsive Son]] to draw cards and burn opponents for 2 each activation.
As a backup, [[Otharri, Suns' Glory]] turns the same experience counters into attacking Rebel tokens.
Use proliferate pieces like [[Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus]] and [[Inexorable Tide]] to double up on every counter in play.

keep: [[Jeska's Will]] alongside a God gives mana and cards to chain spells together.
sendBack: A fixer with nothing to cast after it stalls out before Gods arrive.

tips.text: [[Inexorable Tide]] proliferates on every spell cast, growing the counters [[Kratos, Stoic Father]] places each end step.
[[Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus]] doubles every proliferate trigger, including those from [[Contentious Plan]].
[[Otharri, Suns' Glory]] turns the experience counters granted by [[Kratos, Stoic Father]] into attacking Rebel tokens.
[[Atreus, Impulsive Son]] draws and discards for each experience counter [[Kratos, Stoic Father]] has generated.

plans.primary: Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow gets evasive Ninjas through unblocked, triggering combat damage that drains life off revealed cards.
backups: Extra-turn spells like Time Warp or Temporal Mastery can chain additional attacks to push through more damage.
Reanimate can cheat a creature like Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni into play for value off a ninjutsu swing.

reply.overview: This Dimir deck centers on [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]], using unblockable creatures and ninjutsu to sneak in Ninjas, triggering her ability to reveal cards and drain opponents for their mana value. Cheap evasive bodies like [[Mist-Cloaked Herald]] and [[Changeling Outcast]] enable repeated ninjutsu swaps, while counterspells and removal protect the attack. Extra-turn spells extend the beatdown when the board allows it.

strategy.text: Deploy an unblockable creature such as [[Changeling Outcast]] or [[Slither Blade]] to set up ninjutsu swaps.
Use ninjutsu to swap in [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] or other Ninjas, triggering reveal-and-drain damage.
Chain Ninja triggers from [[Ingenious Infiltrator]] and [[Ninja of the Deep Hours]] to refill your hand each turn.
As a backup, cast extra-turn spells like [[Time Warp]] or [[Temporal Mastery]] to stack more attacks in a row.
Reanimate a strong creature such as [[Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni]] with [[Reanimate]] when the graveyard offers a target.

keep.text: An unblockable creature alongside [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] access starts the plan early.
[[Mistblade Shinobi]] plus a land or two sets up cheap ninjutsu swaps right away.

sendBack.text: A hand heavy on extra-turn spells with no evasive creature can't start attacking.
All black sources and no blue leaves you unable to cast [[Dig Through Time]] or ninjutsu costs.

tips.text: Bounce [[Mist-Cloaked Herald]] with ninjutsu to put [[Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni]] into play attacking and reanimate a creature on damage.
[[Silver-Fur Master]] lowers ninjutsu costs and pumps other Ninjas like [[Mistblade Shinobi]] for cheaper, bigger swings.
[[Satoru Umezawa]] lets any creature card in hand gain ninjutsu, so [[Fallen Shinobi]] can be swapped in cheaply off any attacker.
[[Prosperous Thief]] makes Treasures whenever Ninjas like [[Ninja of the Deep Hours]] connect, fueling further ninjutsu activations.
